user.title: Valheim server status
user.description: Point Home Assistant at the status.json served by your Valheim server (for example the STATUS_HTTP option of lloesche/valheim-server-docker).

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the server running the status web server.
data_description.port: Port of the status web server (STATUS_HTTP_PORT, 80 by default), not the game port.

error.cannot_connect: Could not download status.json from that address.
error.invalid_response: The address answered, but not with a Valheim status.json.

data.stale_after: Treat status as offline when older than (seconds)
